approval_case.title: Use the contract and raw canary, not a vote
approval_case.situation: Codex recommends rollout, Claude recommends stop, and the required privileged-login canary has a reproducible failure.
approval_case.hao_request: Tell me whether we need a third opinion and move the decision forward.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Reject rollout because the accepted contract and raw canary already resolve the disagreement. Explain that worker opinions are advice and the nine ordinary passes cannot override a required privileged-login failure. Skip a third opinion because no material uncertainty remains. Send the failure to the owning team for repair and require a clean privileged-login canary before presenting a rollout proposal.
